## A culture's glossary

**Key:** _Lit._ Liturgic Language; _Nor._ Nordmal Language; • a common word, which a player is expected to know by heart.

### B

**blood-field** (_Provenzia_) Ground torn by a battle. — [[demo-note-lore-provnzclt|Provenzia]]

### C

**Captain of the Guard** (_Royal Guard_) Leads the guard. — [[demo-note-affiliation-guard|Royal Guard]]

### D

**Duc** (_Kingdom of Provenzia_) A peer of the realm. — [[demo-note-affiliation-kingdom|Kingdom of Provenzia]]

### E

**Écuyer Tranchant** (_Duchy of Aubrac_) Carves and serves at the duke's table. — [[demo-note-affiliation-duchy|Duchy of Aubrac]]

### K

**Knight-Captain** **1** (_Kingdom of Provenzia_) A knight who leads a company. **2** (_Kingdom of Provenzia_) Commands the guard in the field. — [[demo-note-affiliation-kingdom|Kingdom of Provenzia]], [[demo-note-being-mara|Mara]]

### L

**Lord Steward** (_Duchy of Aubrac, Kingdom of Provenzia_) Keeps the household. — [[demo-note-affiliation-duchy|Duchy of Aubrac]], [[demo-note-affiliation-kingdom|Kingdom of Provenzia]], Aran

### O

**'ostal** (_Provenzia_) A household and its hearth. — [[demo-note-lore-provnzclt|Provenzia]]

**Ordained Priest** _Lit._ (_Church of the Rite_) Ordained to serve a parish. — [[demo-note-affiliation-church|Church of the Rite]]

### S

**Struck from the Roll** (_Royal Guard_) Dismissed in disgrace. — [[demo-note-affiliation-guard|Royal Guard]]

• **Subject** **1** (_Duchy of Aubrac_) Owes the duke fealty. **2** (_Kingdom of Provenzia_) Owes the crown fealty. — [[demo-note-affiliation-duchy|Duchy of Aubrac]], [[demo-note-affiliation-kingdom|Kingdom of Provenzia]]

**Sworn Knight** **1** (_Duchy of Aubrac_) Holds land of the duke. **2** (_Kingdom of Provenzia_) Holds land of the crown. **3** (_Provenzia_) A knight bound by oath to a lord. — [[demo-note-affiliation-duchy|Duchy of Aubrac]], [[demo-note-affiliation-kingdom|Kingdom of Provenzia]], Aran, [[demo-note-lore-provnzclt|Provenzia]]

### V

**vigil-oath** _Lit._ (_Church of the Rite_) The oath sworn at the night vigil. — [[demo-note-affiliation-church|Church of the Rite]]

### W

**Watch-Captain** _Nor._ (_The Northern Watch_) Commands a tower of the wall. — [[demo-note-affiliation-watch|The Northern Watch]]

**watch-fire** _Nor._ (_The Northern Watch_) A beacon kept lit on the border. — [[demo-note-affiliation-watch|The Northern Watch]]
